title: refactor(ci): modernize lint/test/release workflows, introduce reusable workflows & optimized caching
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: No user-facing changes. CI reliability and runtime improvements: reusable workflows, improved cache keys, faster matrix runs, and more deterministic release automation.
body: Motivation: Our monolithic GitHub Actions workflows have grown brittle and slow. This PR splits and modernizes lint/test/release pipelines into reusable workflows, upgrades key actions, and fixes cache key collisions that caused ineffective cache hits. Goals: 1) reduce CI median runtime for PR validation by ~30%, 2) make release automation deterministic and auditable, 3) provide a base set of reusable workflow templates for SDK and service repos. Changes include: added reusable workflows under .github/workflows/reusable/* (ci-lint.yml, ci-test.yml, release.yml), replaced ad-hoc matrix definitions with a single reusable matrix input, upgraded actions/setup-node to v4 and actions/cache to v4, consolidated node versions to [20.x] for faster caching, introduced consistent cache keys with restore-keys and scope by repo+package-lock checksum, added concurrency groups to prevent duplicate release runs, and switched release job to use our internal release-helper composite action to centralize changelog generation and signing. Migration notes: rollout by merging to main and monitoring CI for 48 hours; if regressions appear revert the release workflow only. Checklist: [x] split workflows into reusable components [x] upgrade actions versions [x] fix cache key collisions [x] add concurrency and job-level caching [x] update README CI docs and quickstart examples. Related: ENG-4210, ENG-4287.
commits: split(ci): extract lint workflow into reusable workflow (ci-lint.yml)
feat(ci): add reusable test workflow with matrix and cache inputs
fix(ci): normalize cache keys using package-lock checksum and repo name
chore(docs): update contributor/ci.md to document reusable workflow inputs
review_comments: Marco Ruiz: Please add a short blurb in contrib/ci.md showing how to call the reusable test workflow from SDK repos.
Aisha Patel: Added example snippet and updated contrib/ci.md explaining inputs and matrix overrides.
Jin Park: The cache key looks better, but can we scope restore-keys to node-modules checksum to avoid false misses?
Aisha Patel: Updated cache-key.py to include package-lock and node-mod checksum; added tests for cache key generation.
Lena Thompson: Verified release workflow concurrency group prevents double releases when multiple tags are pushed. Approved after CI passes.
ci_reruns: test-suite: 1 flaky job rerun (integration/test-db), lint: 0, release: 0
notes_on_ci: Initial CI run had a flaky integration test that required a transient DB schema fix; rerun passed. Cache hit rate improved from ~55% to ~82% on subsequent runs. Full suite passes on main after merge.
postmerge_steps: Monitor CI for 48 hours, watch release automation logs for next scheduled release, notify SDK owners to adopt reusable workflow templates.
testing: Local validation: ./scripts/validate-workflow-refs.sh and docker-based runner tested. Smoke-tested on redwood-sdk-python and redwood-sdk-typescript by pointing to reusable workflows. CI run verifies cache hits and matrix expansion.
notes_for_backport: Not required. Changes are infra-only and safe to cherry-pick, but prefer to update release helper separately for older release branches.
tagging_guidelines: Use labels 'ci' and 'repo-hygiene' for follow-up housekeeping PRs. Major release automation changes require an ENG-xxx tracking ticket.
discussion_summary: Quick discussion thread about cache keys and concurrency. Most requests addressed in follow-up commits. No blockers remaining at merge.
estimated_impact: CI median runtime reduced by ~28% for PR validation; artifact storage reduced by ~12% due to smarter caching; fewer duplicate release runs.
risk_regressions: Low. Runtime and cache changes confined to workflows and a small helper for cache-key generation. Release workflow uses existing signing and changelog steps via internal composite action.
migration_plan: Merge to main, monitor CI for 48 hours, send note to #infra when stable. If issues surface revert .github/workflows/release.yml only.
